messages:
Ashley S: Customer reports a 403 with body "invalid API key" when calling text generation endpoint. They say it worked earlier this morning, started failing after seat migration.
Jordan (CSE): Customer tenant id 58432, says they migrated seats from legacy SSO and sees billing UI showing the new plan but API calls fail. Can share curl.
Ashley S: Pasting sample curl they sent: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-x\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 403.
Ravi (eng): Can you paste the exact response body/headers? 403 with message `invalid API key` could also be our entitlement service returning 403 if plan flags fail.
Ashley S: Full response: `{\"error\":\"invalid API key\",\"code\":403}` plus header `x-entitlement-status: unknown` and `x-plan-version: 0`.
Marta (billing): x-plan-version 0 is telling — looks like plan lookup returned nil. Billing shows customer on Team Pro starting 09:12 UTC. There may be a sync lag from SSO seat import.
Ravi (eng): That header `x-entitlement-status: unknown` means the entitlement cache didn’t have a row for that tenant when the request hit the gateway. The gateway falls back to 403 with generic message (we mask plan 403s as auth errors for legacy UX reasons).
Jordan (CSE): Customer is frustrated because UI shows they have access. They tried re-logging and rotating keys (did not rotate customer key, attempted to create new API key in app — creation succeeded but same 403 on new key).
Ashley S: Repro steps I ran in staging: 1) create tenant, 2) create api key, 3) simulate seat migration job skipping; result: 403 with identical body. Attaching log snippet.
Ravi (eng): Can you paste the entitlement-service trace id from the gateway logs? We need to correlate.
Ashley S: Gateway log: `gateway.req=1945678901 id=g-0a7c trace=tr-94a3 entitlement_lookup=miss tenant=58432`
Ravi (eng): Thanks. That confirms a cache miss. Root cause likely the async plan-sync job didn’t pick up the migration event due to a transient SQS timeout. I can force a sync for tenant 58432 — that should flip plan_version and unblock.
sync-bot: Scheduled manual sync job started for tenant=58432 by Ravi (eng) at 1945678920. Job id js-3312.
Marta (billing): I'll monitor billing side, but happy to confirm once sync completes. Customer PM is on the thread.
Ravi (eng): Manual sync finished at 1945678945. Gateway logs now show `entitlement_lookup=hit plan_version=20240319-3`.
Ashley S: Re-tested with customer's new API key; response 200 and tokens generated. Customer confirmed in chat: "works now, thanks" :thumbsup:.
Jordan (CSE): Customer asked why the UI showed plan earlier than API. Short answer: UI reads from billing master which is updated synchronously during migration; the gateway uses a cached read-through entitlement cache updated async. We'll propose lowering that window.
Marta (billing): Follow-up action: add a write-through event after seat migration to enqueue a high-priority sync (retry on failure x3). Ticketed in FIN-1229.
Ravi (eng): Engineering action: make gateway return clearer error when entitlement lookup misses — currently we surface generic `invalid API key`. Plan: change code path to return `entitlement_missing` in response body for 403 in next minor release. Ticketed in INFRA-4421.
Ashley S: For immediate mitigation, if support sees `x-entitlement-status: unknown` instruct customers to wait ~30s and retry or ask for manual sync (internal). Documenting this workaround in support playbook.
Jordan (CSE): Customer wants an incident summary — I'll prepare a short message for them explaining root cause and actions.
Ashley S: Closing note: customer not charged extra; no data loss; ETA for infra patch? Ravi?
Ravi (eng): ETA for patch and tests ~2 weeks. We'll add monitoring alert for SQS processing latency to detect regressions.
Ashley S: Thanks team. Marking resolved for now, will follow up once INFRA-4421 and FIN-1229 have updates.
